summary: Nintendo and Intelligent Systems' military tactics series, including the Japan-only Famicom/Game Boy/Super Famicom Wars games, the Advance Wars subseries, Battalion Wars action-tactics spin-offs, and Switch remakes.

entries.title: Famicom Wars

emulation.notes: Use only with a legally owned/dumped copy.

primary.why: Famicom Wars is a Japan-only Family Computer game; later Virtual Console releases were availability reissues, not content-expanded versions.
primary.how_to_play: Use original Japanese Family Computer hardware/cartridge, or a legally dumped ROM through an NES/Famicom emulator if you own the game.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remake; later Virtual Console releases were emulated reissues.

primary.version: Advance Wars 1+2: Re-Boot Camp remake of Advance Wars
primary.why: The Switch remake offers modern 3D presentation and current hardware access while covering the Advance Wars campaign; the Game Boy Advance original remains important for original pixel-art preservation.

entries.remaster_caveats: Re-Boot Camp remakes the presentation and feel rather than preserving the GBA game exactly.
